The documentation parts hold. The AAR-metadata part (no library needs desugaring) was not re-checked here. Two nuances: (1) desugaring is not only about java.time. It also covers java.nio.file and the Java 11+ APIs that Android added after 24 (the java8-support page lists them), although Kotlin code rarely touches them. (2) The same page says D8 cannot desugar MethodHandle.invoke/invokeExact, which need minSdk 26 or shrinking. This matters only if a future dependency uses them; the minSdk 24 probe build shows none does today. The official snippet still shows desugar_jdk_libs 2.0.3, but 2.1.5 is the latest on Google Maven.

Android 17 app memory limits apply to all apps on Android 17, whatever the target. Apps over the limit are killed with 'MemoryLimiter:AnonSwap' in ApplicationExitInfo. Targeting API 37 also caps RemoteViews bitmap memory for app widgets (an IllegalArgumentException over the limit) and makes static final fields unmodifiable through reflection. Both matter if Rouxtine adds a home-screen widget or uses reflection-heavy libraries. Source: https://developer.android.com/about/versions/17/behavior-changes-17

NotificationManagerCompat.createNotificationChannel(NotificationChannelCompat) is a no-op on pre-26 devices, so a manual SDK_INT guard isn't needed. Source: https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/core/app/NotificationManagerCompat

Samsung's own support page confirms that 'Buttons' is the default navigation type and gives the path Settings > Display > Navigation bar. This is primary evidence for sdk-31. Source: https://www.samsung.com/uk/support/mobile-devices/optimised-navigation-bar-functions-on-galaxy-devices/

Android 17 adds autonomous Bluetooth re-pairing after bond loss for all apps: ACTION_PAIRING_REQUEST gains EXTRA_PAIRING_CONTEXT, and ACTION_KEY_MISSING is sent only if re-pairing fails. This is relevant only to smart cubes that bond. Source: https://developer.android.com/about/versions/17/behavior-changes-all
